provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: Gradx0/Gradx use a centered difference over 2*DX but divide only by DX (L158,L179) — the 'slope' compared against SlopeCap is twice the actual centered-difference slope, or a one-sided-scaled definition; not clarified in file
audit_member_text: Both the initial and iterative central differences use points I-1 and I+1 (or J-1/J+1) but divide by DX/DY at L158-L159 and L179-L180 rather than the two-cell distance 2*DX/2*DY. If SlopeCap is a physical |dh/dx| threshold as the module comments state, slopes are doubled and smoothing is triggered too aggressively.

base_member_text: the smoothing stencil coefficients 0.4+4*0.15=1.0 conserve the sum only on uniform fields; Depth1 at masked/boundary-adjacent cells uses Depth0 neighbors that may be outside the corrected set

change_percentage is written into tmp1, a GLOBAL temporary (L185) — thread-unsafe reuse; locals Ifile,K,K5,K10,K15,nreq,len,req,status,myint,TMP_NAME(in CORRECTION) are declared but unused (the MPI_WAITALL usage is commented out @L206)

SmoothBelowDepth semantics: MASK0=0 (excluded from correction) where Depth0<SmoothBelowDepth — with the -LARGE default nothing is excluded; the name suggests smoothing BELOW a depth but the code excludes below it; intent ambiguity noted
iteration cap 1000 and threshold 0.05 are hard-coded; convergence is on max relative change, reduced across ranks each iteration; phi_exch/phi_int_exch/PutFile are cross-file

audit_member_text: Gradx and Grady are allocated at L126-L129 without initialization and assigned only where MASK0==1 at L178-L180. Masked cells retain undefined values, yet the entire arrays are exchanged at L219-L220 and written at L247-L249.

Within the last iteration Gradx/Grady are computed from the pre-update Depth0 at L179-L180, then Depth1 is smoothed and copied to Depth0 at L183-L196. On convergence exit the output gradients therefore describe the preceding bathymetry, not the final Depth assigned at L216; they are never recomputed after the loop.
The loop starts pointcount at 0 (L99), tests pointcount<=1000 at L166, and increments after every update at L198, permitting 1001 smoothing iterations although the apparent cap is 1000.
